_about: SL_MagicMenu_SpellResearch strings, English. archetype.<i>.name = Spell Research archetype i as SR Prisma names it (ARCHETYPES order), archetype.<i>.short = the same without the group word (Area, not Area Targeting) - the keys SR Prisma's own translation tables will use. The block shows short, falling back to name.
title: Research Archetypes
reason.notSetup: Run Import Spells in Spell Research's MCM first
reason.listsEmpty: Spell Research has no spell lists yet - run its Import
reason.unknownSpell: Spell Research does not know this spell
reason.noArchetypes: Spell Research files no element, targeting or technique for this spell
reason.noTier: Spell Research has this spell in no tier list
reason.unknownArchetype: ? - no research knowledge of it at this spell's tier yet
reason.noResponse: Spell Research Prisma does not respond
notify.refused: Cannot open the research window (you may be in combat or missing the item it needs)
notify.busy: Another window is open, so the research window did not open
notify.badMessage: Spell Research Prisma did not understand the request - update both mods
